preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the array N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the array A must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(any(A[i] < A[i+1] < A[i+2] or A[i] > A[i+1] > A[i+2] for i in range(len(A)-2)) for A in interesting_arrays)
postconditions.description: If no interesting array exists, output -1; otherwise, output any interesting array.
